title: Record the edge ratio against p/6400 (no new κ)
body:
## Result

On the edge layout `p = 2^{24} - 2 = 16777214`, `ell = 24`, `r_max = 4`, the envelope ratio is exactly 12. Then `12 · 6400 = 76800` is strictly below `p`, so `12 < p/6400`. The quotient is 218 with remainder 34814, and `p/6400 - 12 = 2609 + 2814/6400`.

No new κ. The selected exponent stays `60403/20000000`. `C_E` is not evaluated.

This answers the open question of PR #4925. The verifier rebuilds the layout from the constructor on main and does not replay that predecessor.

## Test plan

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-reservoir-edge-allowance
```

Expected token: `PASS_CRT_RESERVOIR_EDGE_ALLOWANCE threshold=76800 quotient=218 remainder=34814`.
